svg.text: BQ25798EVM in place of the Ag105: wiring (board rev 20260622, round 3 r1)
docs/charger_bq25798_wiring_design_2026-11-05.md sections A.2-A.8 are the netlist; this drawing must match them
SNS-BT INA253 (55.1, 23.6 mm): GND/REF1 pad -> T9
CHG footprint (Ag105 holes) -> carrier CR header pins
pins 1-10 at board x 46.0 mm (input side); 11-22 at x 21.0 mm (battery side); table A.8
Teensy 4.1 breakout J1 / J2 (female, two positions per pin)
pin 8 CHG_CE_RB (in, far end; RENC2 pull-up)
CO-5V pad 1 (+5 V) -> T18, keep-alive option only (DNP). T1/T2: 10.0k at the joint, then the wire.
Pins 5, 6, 18, 19 reach CR through CHG pads 11, 3, 8, 7 (no tap). Pin 20 kept for WDOG1_B (R5).
Pin 7 unused (ROS / old encoder supply net, T-A-01). Pin 2 spare (P24, optional PURGE_SENSE).
CR CHG adapter carrier (31 x 33 mm, 2 oz)
22 header pins = CHG pads (A.2); pin-level netlist B.8
OUT: D103 40 V 3 A Schottky + C103 1 uF at the pins
MODE open, SHDN open, PGTH + PGOOD to GND
U102 H1: V-MOT (T1) vs VBUS (T2C), ratio 1.089
U103 UVB: VBUS > 13.35 / 13.71 V (same T2 wire)
U104 BT_OK: BT-CURR (T8) < 19.75 mV, Kelvin T9 + R143
BAV199 input clamps; outputs LOW when unpowered/POR
readbacks: H1 -> T13, H2c -> T14, BT_OK -> T15
H2c = FCC . BTB_OFF . BT_OK . FCI_OK . ((UVB . FCCEIL) + H1)
QQ = U111 one-shot (QUAL edge, cleared by P5), 0.30-0.40 s
ILIM_REL = (GATE + QQ) . ARM_OK -> W5 pins 7 and 8
inputs: FCC T5, RGN T4, BTB T3, QUAL T10, FCCEIL T11, HB T21,
P5 pad 11; pull-downs on every Teensy-driven input
-> VCHG (pads 18/19). Fit only if T-B-09 fails
J101 2x7 shrouded -> W5 14-way ribbon to EIB J201
SCL/SDA/GND pads -> W7 to EVM J8; R145/R146 2.7k pull-ups
STAT pad 3: R107 10k to 3V3 -> W5 pin 4
THERM pad 13 -> W6 (only if NTC, T-E-09)
readback in: W5 11 ILIM_SENSE -> R125 -> T12; W5 13 CE_SENSE -> T20
STAT: E7 TP38 -> W5 4; AGND: E8 TP49
unpowered: /CE HIGH, Q201 on, Q203 off
E1 TP27 REGN E2 JP14 (ILIM side)
E7 TP38 STAT E8 TP49 AGND
JP17, R42, R21, R39, R40, JP32, JP7, JP30 out
no capacitor added at the input
W5 14-way ribbon, <= 0.30 m (CR J101 -> EIB J201)
1 GND 2 3V3 3 GND 4 STAT 5 CE_DRV 6 GND 7 REL_A
8 REL_B 9 RFC_OFF 10 GND 11 ILIM_SNS 12 GND 13 CE_SNS 14 GND
